canada.title: Latest science shows chemicals in many everyday items pose a growing threat, UN report says
canada.summary: Chemicals in many everyday items that tinker with a body’s hormones are a growing threat to human health and the environment, and science now better understands the harm they cause, a new United Nations report said Tuesday. Endocrine-disrupting chemicals, or EDCs, are found in many plastic items, personal care products, pharmaceuticals, toys, household goods, electronics […]

canada.title: Trillium College students disappointed at selective return to classes
canada.summary: Students at one career college are decrying its approach to the OSAP pause, with the school allowing only those who can pay without the financial aid to continue learning.

canada.title: Mohawk teacher, 73, earns McGill’s first PhD in Indigenous Language Revitalization
canada.summary: Mary Onwá:ri Tekahawákhwen McDonald has taught the Mohawk language to thousands of students over the past decades, from elementary school all the way to university level.

canada.title: Drivers line up as fuel price falls below $1 in northwest Winnipeg
canada.summary: Winnipeg drivers are lining up at one gas station for fuel prices not seen in the city in a long time.

canada.title: Ottawa pledges up to $14M for Mactung tungsten project in Yukon
canada.summary: On Monday, the federal government announced $14 million in funding to advance the Mactung tungsten project, owned by Fireweed Metals, in the Yukon. The U.S. Department of Defense and Ottawa previously pledged about $35 million for the project in December 2024.

canada.title: Victoria County Warden Jackie Organ: From a lobster fishing boat to municipal council
canada.summary: How Victoria County's warden exchanged fishing gear for a spot in local politics.

canada.title: 'It’s baffling': Abbotsford pushes Ottawa for more mitigation action 5 years after 2021 flood
canada.summary: Five years after devastating flooding in Abbotsford's Sumas Prairie, leaders are calling for Ottawa to better protect the region, especially as the federal and provincial governments vouch for nation building and supercharging B.C. in the name of the economy.

canada.title: Q&A: Triage liaison physician says new position shows early promise
canada.summary: Emergency doctor, Dr. Colin Del Castilho, is now working as a triage liaison physician at South Health Campus in Calgary. Even after one shift, he said he could see the promise of the new program.

canada.title: Moncton to consider vacant land tax once allowed by province
canada.summary: Moncton officials say the city will consider a tax on vacant land and homes once allowed by the provincial government. The city's mayor and a councillor hope it will result in redevelopment of vacant downtown land and boost housing.

canada.title: Former Red Deer mayor seriously hurt in hit and run calls for stricter rules on e-bikes, e-scooters
canada.summary: Former Red Deer mayor Ken Johnston is calling for changes to e-bike and e-scooter rules in the central Alberta city after he was seriously injured by one of the vehicles in what police are calling a hit-and-run.

canada.title: Kamloops businesses dealing with dust, reduced parking as arts centre construction continues
canada.summary: Businesses in downtown Kamloops are being impacted by a multi-year construction project, with work underway to build the $211-million Kamloops Centre for the Arts.

canada.title: Radon gas triggers cancer battle and advocacy work for Sask. woman
canada.summary: Christine Elliott learned about radon gas and its risks after a cancer diagnosis.

canada.title: Religious symbols ban for Quebec schoolchildren? Conservatives leave door open
canada.summary: Quebec Conservative Leader Eric Duhaime is leaving the door open to supporting the PQ government's plan to extend a religious symbols ban to elementary school students.

canada.title: Manitoba real estate trust hopes to use new federal money to address homelessness
canada.summary: A real estate investment trust says the funding model it's used to build dozens of affordable units this past year could be replicated to help the federal government address homelessness in Manitoba.

canada.title: Jury hears closing arguments in trial of Saint John man accused of killing wife
canada.summary: Crown prosecutors and defence lawyers made their closing arguments in the trial of Saint John man charged with second-degree murder of his wife in the early hours of Christmas Eve in 2024.

canada.title: Man accused of threatening N.S. chief medical officer and daughter agrees to peace bond
canada.summary: Charges against a 31-year-old Cherry Brook, N.S., man who allegedly threatened Dr. Robert Strang have been dismissed after the man agreed to a five-year peace bond that prohibits him from communiciating with Strang or posting about him on social media.

canada.title: ‘Name him’: Clergy abuse survivors call on church to identify N.L. priest sent for treatment in 1975
canada.summary: An international organization of clergy abuse survivors and advocates is calling on a Roman Catholic diocese in Newfoundland to release the name of a priest who was sent away for treatment more than 50 years ago.
